photos.desc: A slightly better picture of the Barred Owl (Strix varia. Right, this is a Barred Owl?) that was hanging out right by the trail, distressing a mess of robins.
Barred owls are a common site in Cherokee NF. Their call is enjoyed by many, especially during the spring of the year in the Cherokee National Forest. USDA Forest Service Photo.
